description.en: High-frequency irregular and regular verbs powering everyday Italian conversation.
description.zh-CN: 支撑日常意大利语交流的最核心高频动词（规则与不规则）。

translations.zh-CN: 是 / 存在 (最基础辅助动词)

pronunciationNotes.en: Irregular auxiliary verb. Double "ss" is prolonged.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 核心助动词。双辅音“ss”要稍作延长。如：Io sono（我是）。

exampleSentence.it: Voglio essere felice.
exampleSentence.en: I want to be happy.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 我想要幸福。

translations.zh-CN: 有 / 拥有 (核心辅助动词)

pronunciationNotes.en: The "h" in conjugated forms (ho, hai, ha, hanno) is completely silent in Italian.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 其变位形式中（ho, hai, ha, hanno）字母“h”始终不发音。如：Ho fame（我饿了）。

exampleSentence.it: Hai tempo oggi?
exampleSentence.en: Do you have time today?
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 你今天有空吗？

pronunciationNotes.en: Very common motion verb. Irregular in present tense: vado, vai, va...
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 常用位移动词。现在时变位不规则：vado（我去）, vai（你去）, va（他去）。

exampleSentence.it: Dobbiamo andare a Roma.
exampleSentence.en: We must go to Rome.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 我们必须去罗马。

pronunciationNotes.en: Used in dozens of common idioms (e.g. fare la doccia = take a shower, fare colazione = have breakfast).
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 万能搭配动词。如 fare colazione（吃早饭）、fare una passeggiata（散步）。

exampleSentence.it: Cosa vuoi fare stasera?
exampleSentence.en: What do you want to do tonight?
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 你今晚想做什么？

translations.zh-CN: 想要 / 意愿 (情态动词)

pronunciationNotes.en: Modal verb. The conditional form "Vorrei" (I would like) is the polite way to order.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 情态动词。点餐时用条件式“Vorrei...”（我想来一份...）极具礼貌。

exampleSentence.it: Vorrei un bicchiere di vino, grazie.
exampleSentence.en: I would like a glass of wine, thank you.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 我想要一杯葡萄酒，谢谢。

translations.zh-CN: 能够 / 可以 (许可/能力)

pronunciationNotes.en: Modal verb expressing possibility or permission: "Posso...?" = May I...?
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 情态动词。“Posso entrare?”意为“我可以进来吗？”。

exampleSentence.it: Posso pagare con carta di credito?
exampleSentence.en: Can I pay by credit card?
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 我可以用信用卡付款吗？

translations.zh-CN: 必须 / 应该 / 欠(钱)

pronunciationNotes.en: Modal verb of obligation: "Devo andare" = I have to go.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 表示义务或必要性。Devo andare = 我得走了。Quanto le devo? = 我欠您多少钱？

exampleSentence.it: Devo partire presto domani.
exampleSentence.en: I have to leave early tomorrow.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 我明天必须早点出发。

pronunciationNotes.en: "gia" sounds like "jià" in Chinese pinyin.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: “-gia-”发音如汉语拼音“jià”。意大利美食文化核心动词。

exampleSentence.it: Andiamo a mangiare una pizza!
exampleSentence.en: Let's go eat a pizza!
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 我们去吃披萨吧！

pronunciationNotes.en: Short infinitive contracted from historical "bevere". Present forms: bevo, bevi, beve...
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 由古意大利语 bevere 缩减而来。现在时变位如：bevo（我喝）, bevi（你喝）。

exampleSentence.it: Cosa vuoi bere?
exampleSentence.en: What do you want to drink?
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 你想喝什么？

pronunciationNotes.en: Regular 1st conjugation verb (-are).
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 规则第一变位动词。Parlo italiano = 我讲意大利语。

exampleSentence.it: Vorrei parlare con il direttore.
exampleSentence.en: I would like to speak with the manager.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 我想和经理谈谈。

translations.zh-CN: 理解 / 明白 / 领会

pronunciationNotes.en: 3rd conjugation verb with "-isc-" infix in present: capisco, capisci, capisce...
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 第三变位中插入“-isc-”音节的典型动词：Io capisco（我明白）。

exampleSentence.it: Ora capisco la regola grammaticale.
exampleSentence.en: Now I understand the grammar rule.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 现在我明白这条语法规则了。

pronunciationNotes.en: Common phrase: "Ci vediamo!" = See you later! / See each other!
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 常用道别俚语“Ci vediamo!”（回见 / 待会见）。

exampleSentence.it: Ci vediamo domani sera!
exampleSentence.en: See you tomorrow evening!
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 明晚见！

translations.en: To know (a fact) / To know how to
translations.zh-CN: 知道 (事实/信息) / 会 (做某事)

pronunciationNotes.en: Refers to factual knowledge ('Non lo so') or acquired skills ('So nuotare').
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 指了解客观事实或掌握某种技能。口头禅'Non lo so'(我不知道)。

exampleSentence.it: Sai a che ora apre il negozio?
exampleSentence.en: Do you know what time the store opens?
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 你知道这家店几点开门吗？

translations.zh-CN: 认识 (人) / 熟悉 (城市、地方)

pronunciationNotes.en: 'sc' before 'e' is /ʃ/ (like 'sh'). Distinct from 'sapere'.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 'sce'发sh音，与sapere区分：conoscere专用于人或地理环境。

exampleSentence.it: Conosci bene questa città?
exampleSentence.en: Do you know this city well?
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 你对这座城市很熟悉吗？

pronunciationNotes.en: 'v' is voiced labiodental. Present: vengo, vieni, viene.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 不规则动词，现在时变位：vengo, vieni, viene。v咬唇。

exampleSentence.it: Vieni con noi a prendere un caffè?
exampleSentence.en: Are you coming with us to grab a coffee?
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 你和我们一起去喝杯咖啡吗？

translations.zh-CN: 出去 / 出门 / 离场

pronunciationNotes.en: 'sc' before 'i' makes a /ʃ/ ('sh') sound. Present: esco, esci, esce.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 'sci'发拼音sh音，现在时变位词根变为esco, esci, esce。

exampleSentence.it: Stasera usciamo con gli amici per un aperitivo.
exampleSentence.en: Tonight we're going out with friends for an aperitivo.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 今晚我们和朋友们一起出去喝餐前酒。

pronunciationNotes.en: Regular -are verb. 'pr' requires light trill. Stress on 'pra'.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 规则第一变位动词，购物必备，重音在pra。

exampleSentence.it: Voglio comprare dei souvenir per la mia famiglia.
exampleSentence.en: I want to buy some souvenirs for my family.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 我想给我的家人买一些纪念品。

translations.zh-CN: 支付 / 付款 / 买单

pronunciationNotes.en: P is unaspirated. 'G' before 'a' is hard /ɡ/.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: p不送气，ga为浊辅音g，买单必备核心动词。

exampleSentence.it: Posso pagare con la carta di credito?
exampleSentence.en: Can I pay with credit card?
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 我可以用信用卡付款吗？

translations.en: To take / To catch (transit) / To order (food/drink)
translations.zh-CN: 拿取 / 乘坐(交通) / 点(吃喝)

pronunciationNotes.en: Extremely versatile verb: 'prendo un caffè' = I'll have a coffee.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 万能动词：点餐'prendo...'，搭车'prendo il treno'。重音在pren。

exampleSentence.it: Prendo il treno delle otto per andare a lavoro.
exampleSentence.en: I take the 8:00 train to go to work.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 我乘早晨八点的火车去上班。

pronunciationNotes.en: Short two-syllable verb. Present: do, dai, dà.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 双音节极简动词，现在时变位：do, dai, dà。

exampleSentence.it: Mi puoi dare una mano, per favore?
exampleSentence.en: Can you give me a hand, please?
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 你能帮我一把吗，拜托了？

translations.en: To stay / To remain / To feel (health)
translations.zh-CN: 停留 / 处于 / 身体感觉 (状况)

pronunciationNotes.en: 's' before 't' is voiceless. Used in 'Come stai?' (How are you?).
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 表示停留或身体状态，如'Sto a casa'(我呆在家里)。

exampleSentence.it: Oggi preferisco stare a casa a riposare.
exampleSentence.en: Today I prefer to stay home and rest.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 今天我更想呆在家里休息。

pronunciationNotes.en: Regular -ire verb. Stress on 'mi'. Pure 'i' vowel.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 规则第三变位动词，重音在mi，i元音纯正。

exampleSentence.it: Sono molto stanco, ho bisogno di dormire otto ore.
exampleSentence.en: I am very tired, I need to sleep eight hours.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 我太累了，需要睡足八个小时。

pronunciationNotes.en: 'v' is voiced labiodental. Stress on 'ra'.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: v咬唇发音，重音在倒数第二音节ra。

exampleSentence.it: Lavoro in un'azienda informatica dal lunedì al venerdì.
exampleSentence.en: I work at an IT company from Monday to Friday.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 我周一到周五在一家IT公司上班。

pronunciationNotes.en: 'ia' forms a diphthong /dja/. T is unaspirated stop.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 'dia'为双元音滑音，t不送气。

exampleSentence.it: Studio la lingua italiana tutti i giorni con ItaLink.
exampleSentence.en: I study the Italian language every day with ItaLink.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 我每天都用ItaLink学意大利语。

translations.zh-CN: 询问 / 请求 / 提问

pronunciationNotes.en: 'ch' is hard /k/. Stress on the first syllable 'chie'.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 'ch'发硬辅音k，重音在第一个音节chie。

exampleSentence.it: Posso chiedere un'informazione stradale?
exampleSentence.en: May I ask for street directions?
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 我可以打听一下路吗？

pronunciationNotes.en: Light trill on R. Stress on 'spon'.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 重音在spon，常用于回答问题或接听电话。

exampleSentence.it: Non posso rispondere al telefono adesso, sono in riunione.
exampleSentence.en: I can't answer the phone right now, I'm in a meeting.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 我现在没法接电话，在开会。

pronunciationNotes.en: First 'c' before 'e' is soft /tʃ/ ('che'); second 'c' before 'a' is hard /k/.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 绝佳发音对照词：前一个c遇e发清软音q，后一个c遇a发硬音k。

exampleSentence.it: Cerco la stazione della metropolitana più vicina.
exampleSentence.en: I'm looking for the nearest subway station.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 我在找最近的地铁站。

pronunciationNotes.en: 'tr' has light flap. 'v' requires lower lip contact. Stress on 'va'.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 寻找(cercare)之后找到(trovare)，v咬下唇。

exampleSentence.it: Finalmente ho trovato le mie chiavi di casa!
exampleSentence.en: Finally I found my house keys!
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 我终于找到家里钥匙了！

pronunciationNotes.en: Double 'tt' is held. Common command: 'Aspetta!' (Wait!).
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 双写tt停顿，口语常用祈使句'Aspetta!'(等等！)。

exampleSentence.it: Aspettami qui un momento, arrivo subito.
exampleSentence.en: Wait for me here a moment, I'll be right there.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 在这等我一下，我马上就来。

translations.en: To depart / To leave / To set off
translations.zh-CN: 出发 / 离开 / 动身

pronunciationNotes.en: P and T are unaspirated stops. Stress on 'ti'.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 旅行必备词，p和t均不送气，重音在ti。

exampleSentence.it: A che ora parte il prossimo treno per Venezia?
exampleSentence.en: What time does the next train to Venice depart?
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 下一班去威尼斯的火车几点出发？

pronunciationNotes.en: Double 'rr' requires a pronounced trill.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 双写rr必须有明显的舌尖大舌颤音，重音在va。

exampleSentence.it: Siamo arrivati a Roma in perfetto orario.
exampleSentence.en: We arrived in Rome perfectly on time.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 我们准点抵达了罗马。

pronunciationNotes.en: Stress on 'tra'. Unaspirated 't'.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 日常礼貌邀请'Avanti, entra!'(请进！)。

exampleSentence.it: Posso entrare o è occupato?
exampleSentence.en: May I enter or is it occupied?
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 我可以进来吗，还是里面有人？

translations.en: To hear / To feel / To smell
translations.zh-CN: 听见 / 感觉 / 闻到

pronunciationNotes.en: Covers perception: 'Ti senti bene?' (Do you feel well?).
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 感官动词，表示听见或身心感受：'Non ti sento'(我听不清你说话)。

exampleSentence.it: Senti anche tu questo delizioso profumo di caffè?
exampleSentence.en: Do you also smell this delicious coffee aroma?
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 你也闻到这诱人的咖啡香气了吗？

translations.zh-CN: 倾听 / 听 (有意识地听)

pronunciationNotes.en: Distinct from 'sentire' (passive hearing); 'ascoltare' is intentional listening.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 与sentire(被动听见)不同，ascoltare强调专心倾听。

exampleSentence.it: Mi piace ascoltare la musica lirica italiana.
exampleSentence.en: I like listening to Italian opera music.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 我喜欢听意大利歌剧。

pronunciationNotes.en: Stress on first syllable 'scri'. 'v' is voiced labiodental.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 重音在第一音节scri，v咬唇。

exampleSentence.it: Puoi scrivermi il tuo indirizzo email qui?
exampleSentence.en: Can you write your email address for me here?
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 你能把你的电子邮箱地址写在这儿吗？

pronunciationNotes.en: Double 'gg' before 'e' is strong /ddʒ/. Stress on first syllable.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 双写gg在e前发强音/ddʒ/，重音在第一个音节leg。

exampleSentence.it: Sto leggendo un libro fantastico sulla storia di Roma.
exampleSentence.en: I'm reading a fantastic book about the history of Rome.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 我正在读一本关于罗马历史的绝妙书籍。

pronunciationNotes.en: Two 'v' sounds, both voiced labiodental. Stress on first syllable.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 包含两个v，均需上齿咬下唇发音，重音在vi。

exampleSentence.it: Da quanti anni vivi in Italia?
exampleSentence.en: How many years have you been living in Italy?
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 你在意大利生活几年了？

pronunciationNotes.en: Smooth glide /ju/. T is unaspirated stop. Noun is 'aiuto'.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 'iu'平滑过渡，动词形式为aiutare，名词为aiuto。

exampleSentence.it: Ti posso aiutare a portare quella valigia pesante?
exampleSentence.en: Can I help you carry that heavy suitcase?
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 我能帮你提那个沉重的手提箱吗？

translations.zh-CN: 记得 / 想起 / 牢记

pronunciationNotes.en: Light trill on both R's. Stress on 'da'.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 记忆相关核心词，重音在da。

exampleSentence.it: Non ricordo dove ho parcheggiato la macchina.
exampleSentence.en: I don't remember where I parked the car.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 我想不起来把车停哪儿了。

pronunciationNotes.en: T and C are unaspirated stops. Stress on 'ca'.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 反义词为ricordare，'Non dimenticare!'表示别忘了！

exampleSentence.it: Non dimenticare di convalidare il biglietto prima di salire!
exampleSentence.en: Don't forget to validate the ticket before boarding!
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 上车前别忘了在打票机上打票！
